title: Neon Glass Tubes — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: The idea lights the system
scenes.purpose: Show an idea becoming a connected system: current runs through continuous glass neon tubes one section at a time, and each lit run shows up as coloured light and a reflection on the nearby wall and glossy floor.
visuals: Dark navy wall and glossy floor, seen from a low raking camera angle
Clear glass tubes on standoff mounts with an emissive gas core: teal runs and bulb, pink end rings, an amber spark
Two branches that stay unlit (dim blue-grey) show the rest of the system still to come
Mirrored reflection under the floor, plus local coloured light pools and streaks
Headline and section captions in HTML type at top left

beats.development: The unlit glass sign sits in the dark. The headline fades up and the left pink source ring ignites, its sweep starting at the joint.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Current travels the left run as one contiguous segment, around two bends to the bulb junction, then pauses there (0.85-1.0 s). The wall and floor pick up teal light along the run.
The bulb outline lights as one closed loop from the junction. The base bars and the amber spark then ignite, 'SECTION 1 OF 2 LIT' appears, and the light pauses at the right junction.
The outgoing right run lights to the far pink node, which ignites. The caption changes to 'SECTION 2 OF 2 LIT'.
Settled hold: the whole lit path, its reflections and the readable copy, with the dim branches waiting.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

findings: Every lit section is a single contiguous run, with a short pause at each junction (0.85-1.0 s and 1.75-1.9 s), following the style's timing rule.
Everything is settled by 2.65 s, inside the 2.7 s limit.
justifiedHolds: The 0.35 s end hold lets the viewer read the completed connected path and the final caption.

notes: Renderer: Three.js inside a HyperFrames composition. Motion: one paused GSAP timeline at window.__timelines.video, redrawn on timeline update and on hf-seek.
No preview recipes were supplied; the preview demonstrates the catalogue's characteristic action.
